relations.text: Synopsysは、光学ソリューション事業(OSG)をKeysightへ売却する正式契約を2024年9月3日に結んだ
relations.text_en: Synopsys signed a definitive agreement on September 3, 2024 to sell its Optical Solutions Group (OSG) to Keysight

source.label: Synopsys 10-K
source.quote: Following the determination that it was a necessary step towards obtaining governmental approval of and successfully closing the Ansys Merger, on September 3, 2024, we signed a definitive agreement for the sale of our Optical Solutions Group (OSG) to Keysight Technologies, Inc.

relations.text: AnsysもPowerArtist RTL事業をKeysightへ売却する正式契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Ansys has similarly entered into a definitive agreement with Keysight for the sale of its PowerArtist RTL business

source.label: Synopsys 10-K
source.quote: Ansys has similarly entered into a definitive agreement with Keysight Technologies, Inc. for the sale of its PowerArtist RTL business (such sale, together with the Optical Solutions Divestiture, the Regulatory Divestitures).

relations.text: Keysightは2025年に、SynopsysのOSG取得に5億7800万ドル、AnsysのPowerArtist RTL事業の取得に2600万ドルを使った
relations.text_en: Keysight used $578 million for the acquisition of Synopsys’ OSG and $26 million for Ansys’ PowerArtist RTL Business in 2025

source.label: Keysight Technologies 10-K
source.quote: In 2025, we used $2,022 million, net of cash acquired, for acquisitions, which included $1,415 million, net of $127 million cash acquired, for the acquisition of Spirent, $578 million used for the acquisition of Synopsys’ OSG, $26 million used for acquisition of Ansys’ PowerArtist RTL Business and $3 million used for other acquisition activity.
